meta.name: Elpidio
meta.tagline: Computer science is one of my greatest passions: it always brings new challenges, and it never gets boring.

paragraphs: Born in 1997 and based in Ravello (SA), Italy. I'm a full-stack developer who is always ready to take on new challenges and keep growing, with a particular focus on the web.

Since 2022 I have been building enterprise applications with Java, Spring, TypeScript and Angular; today I develop a microservices platform for OSINT and security intelligence, bringing LLMs and automation into everyday workflows.
My mission is to make people's lives simpler through software.

experiences.title: Software Development Engineer
experiences.description: Full-stack developer within the Software Farm unit, working on an enterprise-grade microservices platform for OSINT and security intelligence. Stack: Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, LangGraph), Java (Spring Boot, Quartz), Angular (standalone components, signals, PrimeNG, Tailwind CSS 4) and containerized infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, KasmVNC).
highlights: AI in decision-making and automation workflows: LLMs, OCR and turning unstructured data into structured data
Application reverse engineering, API analysis and process-flow analysis
Data extraction and analysis; cybersecurity and physical security threat analysis
Tor infrastructure (torapi) and local CPU models for text analysis and data extraction (textmetadata library)

experiences.title: Software Development Engineer
experiences.description: Angular frontend developer on IoT and real-time data visualization projects, building interfaces that turn complex data into clear, accessible information.
highlights: Interactive real-time monitoring dashboards, with OpenSearch for complex data, and live maps for geolocation and asset tracking
PrimeNG application template configurable through JSON, to start or tailor applications for different customers quickly
Internal UI kit on PrimeNG with configurable meta-components, standardizing UI and UX across all company products
CI/CD and semantic versioning for the libraries; Dockerfiles for reproducible frontend image builds
Drag-and-drop page builder (GridStack, NgRx SignalStore) for dynamic, customer-defined views

experiences.title: Software Development Engineer
experiences.description: Outsourced professional at CCH Tagetik: design, development, porting and testing of an enterprise application.
highlights: Design and development of an enterprise application: Java and Spring on the backend, TypeScript and Angular on the frontend
Porting and testing to ensure software quality and functionality
Collaboration with internal and external teams to meet project requirements

experiences.title: BSc in Computer Science (L-31)
experiences.description: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (class L-31), final grade 100/110.
highlights: Thesis: a CNN model to assess the progression of Parkinson's disease

milestones.title: Thesis: a CNN for Parkinson's disease
